name: CyberArk PAM Provider
description: A Keyfactor PAM Provider plugin supporting credential retrieval with a CyberArk Credential Provider. The Central Credential Provider (cloud-hosted) can be used, or the standard Credential Provider with installed SDK.

Parameters.Name: AppId
Parameters.Description: The Application ID with access set up for the Safe used to identify and authenticate requests.

Parameters.Name: Host
Parameters.Description: The hostname (IP address or domain name) and (optionally) port. It should take the format: my.cyberark.instance:404 (note: no https:// included).

Parameters.Name: Site
Parameters.Description: By default, AIMWebService is the site name, but may be deployed to another site name.

Parameters.Name: Safe
Parameters.Description: The name of the Safe the credential resides in.

Parameters.Name: Folder
Parameters.Description: The folder path the credential lives in. If it is nested, use the backwards slash e.g. Root\Folder

Parameters.Name: Object
Parameters.Description: The name of the password object that has the credential.

Parameters.Name: Site
Parameters.Description: By default, AIMWebService is the site name, but may be deployed to another site name.

Parameters.Name: PfxBase64
Parameters.Description: The Base64-encoded PFX certificate used for authentication. This is an alternative to providing a file path. If populated with empty spaces or 'none', it will be ignored and the provider will look for a file path instead. If both PfxBase64 and PfxFilePath are provided, PfxBase64 will take precedence.

Parameters.Name: PfxFilePath
Parameters.Description: The relative or absolute file path to the PFX certificate used for authentication. This is an alternative to providing a Base64-encoded PFX. If populated with empty spaces or 'none', it will be ignored and the provider will look for a Base64-encoded PFX instead. If both PfxBase64 and PfxFilePath are provided, PfxBase64 will take precedence.

Parameters.Name: PfxPassword
Parameters.Description: The password for the PFX certificate used for authentication.
